acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass and producer B.A. Parker talk about a disagreement they’ve been having about a particular word.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Journalist Kelefa Sanneh delves into the story of Laci Green, a famous YouTuber and sex educator. Like any internet celebrity, Laci gets harassed on the internet. No surprise there. What is surprising is who winds up harassing her, and what she does about it.
acts.title: Video Killed the Video Star

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Dodie Horton is a dyed-in-the-wool, glock-toting, blood-red Republican from Louisiana. So why are her fellow Republicans calling her a RINO (Republican In Name Only) and saying that she’s trying to take away their Second Amendment rights? Producer Dana Chivvis reports.
acts.title: Trigger Warning
